confirmation_rule: a code is confirmed by normalized addr:postcode or postal_code tags on OSM nodes, ways or relations wholly inside the checked country polygon, with no contrary addr:country tag; CSC CN excludes HK, MO and TW
field_rule: locality only where every object agrees; point as the median of the objects (never one address), else null; points formatted to eight decimals; no other field from OpenStreetMap
